title: StrategyCandidate
description: One complete candidate decision (HAR-129 section 6, 7): a materially different GTM strategy with its finished action, so the human chooses among real actions and no draft is generated after the click. The worker returns candidates without draft_index and eval_bundle_ref; core assigns the draft and runs the evals, and a candidate inside a StrategySet must carry both.

strategy_type.description: Open vocabulary, generated from the account state (for example stronger_cta, add_stakeholder, clarify_first); lower snake case so judgment inference can compare candidates.

ranking.description: 1 is Ghost's best; unique within a set.

rationale.description: Why this strategy is plausible for the current state.

state_refs.description: AccountState fields the strategy relies on (same vocabulary as EvalResult.state_refs).

knowledge_refs.description: Company knowledge applied to this candidate (every knowledge object the candidate used).

action_class.description: The decision class of the strategy (HAR-97 decision vocabulary, HAR-128). action_type is the executable tool vocabulary; action_class says what kind of move the strategy is and maps onto action_type (see allOf): REPLY -> send_email, MEETING -> schedule_meeting, SHARE_DOCUMENT -> share_document, INTERNAL_TASK, ASK_RESEARCH (research, account brief, ask the internal owner), CRM_UPDATE and HUMAN_REVIEW (hand to a human) -> internal_note, WAIT -> wait, NO_ACTION and UNKNOWN (the evidence does not say) -> no_action, EXPANSION_MOTION (commercial expansion outreach) -> send_email, schedule_meeting or share_document. Under a CANDIDATE or UNRESOLVED transition core restricts EXPANSION_MOTION.

selected_eval_suite.description: The eval suite core routed THIS candidate to, from the transition status, the state and the candidate's own action (routing.v1.json action_routes); null when no suite applies. Set by core after generation (the worker never sends it); it repeats eval_bundle.selected_eval_suite so the choice is visible on the candidate itself.

subject.description: Card field; equals full_action_artifact.subject (a SQL CHECK keeps them equal).

five_questions.description: The five questions every visible recommendation answers (HAR-128): what changed, why we think the state changed, what remains unknown, what prior knowledge applies, why this is the next action. Each answer is non-empty; rationale stays the one-paragraph summary.

preview.description: Meaningful excerpt of the body for the card (no new text).

draft_index.description: The AgentRun draft that stores this candidate's output, so EvalResult(agent_run_id, draft_index) rows apply unchanged. Assigned by core.

eval_bundle_ref.description: EvalBundle id. Assigned by core after the evals ran.

allOf.description: Ghost prefers exactly its top-ranked candidate.
An email strategy addresses someone, over the email channel (as AgentRunOutput).
action_class REPLY is carried out as send_email.
action_class MEETING is carried out as schedule_meeting.
action_class SHARE_DOCUMENT is carried out as share_document.
action_class INTERNAL_TASK is carried out as internal_note.
action_class WAIT is carried out as wait.
action_class NO_ACTION is carried out as no_action.
action_class ASK_RESEARCH is carried out as internal_note.
action_class EXPANSION_MOTION is carried out as send_email or schedule_meeting or share_document.
action_class CRM_UPDATE is carried out as internal_note.
action_class UNKNOWN is carried out as no_action.
action_class HUMAN_REVIEW is carried out as internal_note.
